windowGives: approvals in the window; the state the human built
contrast: W2 and W1 vs W0 (the policy is the same in W1 and W2)
symptom: My cart has Desk lamp x1 and Lantern x2 but the total says $91.99; it should be $65.48. It went wrong after I changed the quantities with - and +.
cause: useCartTotal caches totals by a key made of the line ids and the number of items, not each line's quantity; Desk lamp x2 + Lantern x1 and Desk lamp x1 + Lantern x2 have the same key, so the second shows the first's total.
